title: A Computational Framework to Evaluate Interactions of BPA and Its Analogs with Human Liver X Receptor-Beta for Health Risk Assessment.
authors: Pathak, Rajesh Kumar; Kumar, Saurav; Kumar, Vikas
one_liner_zh: 该文用分子对接和MD模拟评估BPA及其类似物与LXRbeta蛋白的相互作用，对象为小分子-核受体，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或TF-DNA结合建模，仅部分物理模拟方法可借鉴，与课题关联度低。
abstract: Bisphenols are widely used in industrial applications to produce plastics and other consumer products. Among them, bisphenol A (BPA) is the most extensively studied due to its well-documented endocrine-disrupting effects and its association with various health conditions, including metabolic disorders and liver disease. Due to its known toxicity, BPA use has been restricted in many countries, leading to the emergence of several structural analogs. Recent studies have shown that BPA can interfere with normal liver metabolism by interacting with Liver X Receptor-beta (LXRbeta). Although some BPA analogs have also been reported to cause toxicity, their exact effects on LXRbeta remain unclear. In this study, we investigated the interaction between BPA analogs and LXRbeta using molecular docking. BPA and the known LXRbeta ligand G58 were used as reference compounds. The top 10 BPA analogs were further evaluated for their pharmacokinetics and pharmacodynamics properties. Molecular dynamics simulations over 100 ns were performed to study the dynamic behavior of LXRbeta in complex with these analogs. Binding free energies were then calculated using the MM-PBSA method. Our results showed that several BPA analogs exhibited predicted stronger binding activities to LXRbeta than BPA. Although some analogs shared similar pharmacokinetic and pharmacodynamic profiles with BPA, their stronger interaction with LXRbeta raises concerns about their potential hepatotoxicity. This study employs a robust in silico framework to predict that commonly used BPA alternatives may pose a greater potential hepatotoxic risk than the banned parent compound, highlighting the value of computational approaches in prioritizing chemicals for further experimental assessment.
abstract_zh: 双酚类化合物广泛应用于工业生产中，用于制造塑料及其他消费品。其中，双酚A (BPA) 因具有充分记录的内分泌干扰效应及其与多种健康状况（包括代谢紊乱和肝脏疾病）的关联而成为研究最为广泛的一种。鉴于其已知毒性，许多国家已限制BPA的使用，这促使多种结构类似物的出现。近期研究表明，BPA可通过与肝X受体β (LXRbeta) 相互作用干扰正常肝脏代谢。尽管一些BPA类似物也被报道具有毒性，但它们对LXRbeta的确切影响仍不清楚。在本研究中，我们利用分子对接 (molecular docking) 技术探讨了BPA类似物与LXRbeta之间的相互作用。BPA及已知的LXRbeta配体G58作为参考化合物。对排名前10的BPA类似物进一步评估了其药代动力学和药效学特性。进行了100 ns的分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟，以研究LXRbeta与这些类似物复合物的动态行为。随后采用MM-PBSA方法计算了结合自由能。我们的结果表明，若干BPA类似物对LXRbeta表现出预测的更强结合活性，优于BPA。尽管一些类似物与BPA具有相似的药代动力学和药效学特征，但它们与LXRbeta的更强相互作用引发了对潜在肝毒性的担忧。本研究采用稳健的计算框架 (in silico framework) 预测，常用BPA替代品可能比被禁用的母体化合物具有更大的潜在肝毒性风险，凸显了计算方法在优先选择化学品进行进一步实验评估中的价值。
